name: Bengtson Pumpkin Farm
description: Bengtson Pumpkin Farm is an agritourism farm in 13341 w. 151st street, IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
